title: Lifted external evaluation chain models with common shifted targets
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $X,Y,P$ schemes and $a:P\to X$, $b:P\to Y$ morphisms [def-pc-scheme]. Use small etale sites in a common module universe [def-weil-size-convention], ordinary module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], exact inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and direct-sum tensor complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Let $E,H$ be bounded flat cochain complexes on $X,Y$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Let $I_K,I_L$ be K-injective complexes representing bounded-below objects $K,L$, and suppose $F=a^{-1}K\otimes_A^Lb^{-1}L$ is bounded below [def-pur-kinjective-complex, def-kun-derived-tensor]. Write $\underline U_T$ for constant realization [def-kun-constant-sheaf], and $\mathsf H_T(B,M)=R\Gamma(T,R\mathcal Hom_A(B,M))$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom, def-kun-constant-projection-morphism]. Suppose given quasi-isomorphisms of $A$-complexes
$$\alpha:U\to\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}_X(E,I_K),\qquad\gamma:V\to\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}_Y(H,I_L)$$
with $U,V$ K-flat with flat terms [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. Put $t_X(w\otimes e)=\alpha(w)(e)$ and $t_Y(z\otimes h)=\gamma(z)(h)$. Suppose chain maps $u:\underline U_X\otimes_A E\to N_K$, $v:\underline V_Y\otimes_A H\to N_L$, $c_K:N_K\to I_K$ and $c_L:N_L\to I_L$ are given, with $N_K,N_L$ K-flat with flat terms, $c_K,c_L$ quasi-isomorphisms, and $c_Ku\simeq t_X$, $c_Lv\simeq t_Y$. Set $T=a^{-1}N_K\otimes_A b^{-1}N_L$, $G=a^{-1}E\otimes_A b^{-1}H$.

The complex $T$ represents $F$. For every K-injective resolution $i:T\to J$, the formula on local homogeneous sections
$$p(w\otimes z)(e\otimes h)=(-1)^{sq}i\bigl(a^{-1}u(w\otimes e)\otimes b^{-1}v(z\otimes h)\bigr),\quad |w|=r,\ |z|=s,\ |e|=q,$$
defines a chain map $p:U\otimes_A V\to\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}_P(G,J)$ [def-pur-hom-complex]. Under the canonical identifications of its source with $\mathsf H_X(E,K)\otimes_A^L\mathsf H_Y(H,L)$ and its target with $\mathsf H_P(G,F)$, its localization is the transpose of the tensor of pulled-back derived evaluations with Koszul interchange. This assertion holds for every choice of the displayed representatives and homotopy lifts, so all give the same derived morphism.

Use $B[1]^q=B^{q+1}$ and $d_{B[1]}=-d_B$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For any complex $B$ and K-injective $I$ on one of these sites, the maps
$$\theta_B:\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}(B[1],I)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}(B,I)[-1],\qquad(\theta_Bf)^p=(-1)^nf^{p-1}\quad(|f|=n)$$
are chain isomorphisms realizing the first-variable derived Hom shift. The shifted resolution $U[-1]\to\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}_X(E[1],I_K)$ is $\theta_E^{-1}\alpha[-1]$. The formula
$$\eta_{U,E}:\underline{U[-1]}_X\otimes_A E[1]\xrightarrow{\sim}\underline U_X\otimes_A E,\qquad w\otimes e\longmapsto(-1)^r w\otimes e\quad(w\in U[-1]^r)$$
is a chain isomorphism, and the shifted chain evaluation is $t_X\eta_{U,E}$. It is factored up to homotopy by $u\eta_{U,E}$ and the same $c_K,N_K$. The identical assertion holds for $V,H,v$. Consequently the shifted and unshifted external evaluations may all use the same target $T$ and the same $J,i$.
